_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to voice.local.json (gitignored) to record YOUR team's house style. SKILL.md 'Voice' holds the generic defaults; this file overrides them for your room. Record PATTERNS ONLY — never a channel name, a person's name, an employer, or copied post content. To build it, skim recent posts in the channels the brief lands in and describe how they are structured.
_how_to_use: If config/voice.local.json exists, the skill follows it over the SKILL.md defaults. Delete the file to fall back to defaults.
register: <e.g. 'direct and plain; first person is fine; dry humor in the framing, never in the analysis'>
item_shape: <e.g. 'content-matched emoji + bold sentence-case headline carrying the verdict, then 1-2 short paragraphs'>
opener: <e.g. 'one honest line characterizing the period as a whole, including when it was thin'>
action_style: <e.g. 'one consolidated action block at the end, not a takeaway per item'>
attribution: <e.g. 'name whoever surfaced an item when it came from a person rather than a feed'>
hedging: <e.g. 'state judgment plainly; mark what is unverified; append visible corrections rather than silently editing'>
emoji: <'none' by default. Only set otherwise if your readers actually want them in a brief — chat style and brief style differ.>
layout: <How much structure the brief needs. Borrow tone from your channels, not their chat formatting: a brief is scanned, so it usually needs MORE structure than a post — headings, bullets, and tables wherever fields repeat. Note any per-item length ceiling here.>
visuals: <Where tables or other visuals earn their place, e.g. 'forward calendar, coverage roster, any at-a-glance comparison'. Note what the delivery channel can actually render.>
